evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament: Superficial and deep components intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Oblique tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with extension to the inferior articular surface.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Nonsurfacing hyperintensity of the posterior horn probably represents intra since degeneration. No definite meniscal tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment: Focal full-thickness chondral loss measuring up to 1.3 cm in size associated subchondral edema.
evidence.Effusion: No joint effusion or loose body.
evidence.Contusion: No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.
evidence.Fracture: No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.
